location_description:
Williamsport is a town in Washington County, Maryland, United States. The population was 1,868 at the 2000 census and 2,137 as of 2010.


== Geography ==
 
Williamsport is located at 39°35′55″N 77°49′6″W (39.598496, −77.818464).According to the United States Census Bureau, the town has a total area of 1.04 square miles (2.69 km2), all land.Williamsport is located 7.69 mi (12.38 km) southwest of Hagerstown and 16.23 mi (26.12 km) north of Martinsburg, West Virginia.
